evals.prompt: Set up Playwright for a new MOL project. The app uses mol-token-bypass for auth in tests, has a custom usecase-id header, Cognito admins and Singpass citizens. Create the playwright config and auth helper.
evals.expected_output: playwright.config.ts and e2e/helpers/auth.ts (or equivalent) with MOL header bypass support for Cognito admin and Singpass citizen

assertions.description: playwright.config.ts is generated
Auth helper file is generated
Auth helper imports MOLSecurityHeaderKeys from @wog/mol-lib-api-contract
mol-token-bypass header is used with value 'true'
Cognito admin type is handled (ADMIN_ID header)
Singpass citizen type is handled (USER_ID + USER_UINFIN headers)
No hardcoded credentials (no literal email/password strings)
baseURL sourced from process.env in playwright.config.ts

evals.prompt: Write E2E tests for a booking creation page. An admin creates bookings, and a Singpass citizen can view their own bookings. Cover the full happy path, auth boundaries (unauthenticated redirect + wrong-role access), and empty state.
evals.expected_output: First a markdown plan (checklist-test-cases/<feature>-checklist.md) with Overview, Seed, and TC-numbered scenarios containing Steps + Expected Results. Then a TypeScript spec file with one test per TC, covering happy path, unauthenticated redirect, unauthorized access (wrong role), and empty state — using MOL header bypass auth. Each spec file should begin with `// plan:` and `// fixture:` header comments.

assertions.description: A plan markdown file is generated under checklist-test-cases/ (filename ending with -checklist.md)
Plan markdown contains an '## Overview' section describing the feature
Plan markdown contains a '## Seed' section listing fixture path, auth pattern, roles, DB pattern
Plan markdown contains 'TC No N' scenario blocks with both 'Steps:' and 'Expected results:' subsections
Plan includes at least one unauthenticated-redirect scenario AND one wrong-role/unauthorized scenario
Spec file is generated
Spec file begins with a '// plan:' comment pointing at the plan markdown
Spec file contains a '// fixture:' comment pointing at the auth-fixture file
Every test title in the spec starts with 'TC No N:' matching a row in the plan
Contains a happy path test (booking creation or citizen view)
Contains unauthenticated redirect test with no auth helper called
Contains unauthorized access test (wrong role / not owner)
Contains empty state test
Uses await expect(...) — not expect(await locator.isVisible())
No page.waitForTimeout() calls
No page.route() calls
No hardcoded credentials as string literals
Selectors use getByRole, getByLabel, or getByText (no CSS class selectors)

evals.prompt: Write E2E tests for the admin dashboard at /admin/dashboard. The page shows the usecase name in a heading. Tests needed: dashboard loads correctly, switching usecases works, and unauthenticated users are redirected to /login.
evals.expected_output: First a markdown plan (checklist-test-cases/dashboard-checklist.md or similar) with Overview, Seed, and TC-numbered scenarios. Then a TypeScript spec file with tests for dashboard load, usecase switching, and unauthenticated redirect. Each spec file should begin with `// plan:` and `// fixture:` header comments.

assertions.description: A plan markdown file is generated under checklist-test-cases/
Plan markdown contains an '## Overview' section
Plan markdown contains a '## Seed' section
Plan markdown contains 'TC No N' scenario blocks with 'Steps:' and 'Expected results:'
Spec file is generated
Spec file begins with '// plan:' header comment
Every test title starts with 'TC No N:' matching a plan row
Contains test for dashboard loading correctly
Contains test for switching usecases
Contains unauthenticated redirect test (no auth helper called)
Uses MOL auth pattern (header bypass or fixture) — not loginViaApi
Uses await expect(...) web-first assertions
No page.waitForTimeout() calls
Selectors use getByRole, getByLabel, or getByText
